title: Pure Harpie
summary: Harpie cards with generic WIND Extra Deck monsters and staples. Most Harpie monsters become Harpie Lady on the field or in the GY, letting Elegant Egotist, Hysteric Sign, and Cyber Slash Harpie Lady work across the entire lineup.

summary.title: Starters
points: Harpie Channeler discards a Harpie card to Special Summon any Harpie monster from the Deck in Defense Position, and becomes Level 7 while you control a Dragon.
Harpie Perfumer searches 1 Spell or Trap that mentions Harpie Lady Sisters on Normal or Special Summon, or 2 with different names if you control a Level 5 or higher Harpie.
Hysteric Sign adds Elegant Egotist on activation, and adds 3 Harpie cards with different names during the End Phase of the turn it is sent from the hand or field to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Harpie Channeler + Harpie Card
steps: Normal Summon Harpie Channeler and discard a Harpie card (ideally Hysteric Sign or Harpie Harpist) to Special Summon Harpie Perfumer from the Deck.
Harpie Perfumer searches Elegant Egotist, which Special Summons Harpie Lady Sisters from the Deck.

With a Level 5+ Harpie on board, Special Summon Harpie Oracle from the hand, then tune Channeler and Perfumer into Cyber Slash Harpie Lady (any Harpie counts as a Tuner for its Synchro Summon) while Hysteric Sign searches 3 Harpie cards in the End Phase.

summary.title: Control & Bosses
points: Cyber Slash Harpie Lady treats any Harpie as a Tuner for its summon and bounces an opponent's monster (or one of your Harpies) whenever a Spell/Trap Card or effect is activated.

Harpie's Pet Dragon - Fearsome Fire Blast Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a Level 6 or lower WIND monster, shields Level 6 or lower Harpies from attacks, and sends a WIND Winged Beast like Harpie Harpist from Deck to GY when sent from field to GY.

Harpie Conductor protects your Harpie monsters from battle or effect destruction by destroying a Spell/Trap you control instead—triggering Hysteric Sign or Harpie Lady Elegance—while Harpie's Pet Phantasmal Dragon and Lightning Chidori pressure the board.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Harpies' Hunting Ground destroys 1 Spell/Trap on the field every time Harpie Lady or Harpie Lady Sisters is Normal or Special Summoned, including your own Set Hysteric Sign.

Harpie Lady Elegance shuffles Harpie Lady Sisters from your Monster Zone into the Deck to Special Summon 3 Harpies with different original names (1 each from hand, Deck, and GY), locking you into WIND monsters for the rest of the turn, and searches a Harpie if destroyed.

Harpie's Feather Rest recycles 3 Harpies from GY to draw 1 (or 2 with a Level 5+ Harpie), Hysteric Party revives as many Harpie Ladies as possible from the GY, and Harpie's Feather Duster wipes the opponent's backrow.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Harpie's Feather Storm is Forbidden in the TCG, Harpie Lady - Elegant Egotist is not released in the TCG yet, and Toon Harpie Lady belongs to the Toon strategy.

exclude.Harpie Lady - Elegant Egotist: Not released in the TCG yet.
exclude.Toon Harpie Lady: Needs Toon World; it plays on the Toon list.
